text_en: Zedekiah was twenty-one years old when he began to reign; he reigned eleven years in Jerusalem. His mother’s name was Hamutal daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah.
text_cn: 漆德克雅登极时，年二十一岁，在耶路撒冷为王十一年，他的母亲名叫哈慕塔耳，是里贝纳人耶肋米雅的女儿。

text_en: He did what was evil in the sight of the Lord , just as Jehoiakim had done.
text_cn: 他行了上主视为恶的事，全像约雅金所行的一样，

text_en: Indeed, Jerusalem and Judah so angered the Lord that he expelled them from his presence. Zedekiah rebelled against the king of Babylon.
text_cn: 因此上主对耶路撒冷和犹大大发忿怒，由自己面前将他们抛弃。以后漆德克雅背叛了巴比伦王。

text_en: And in the ninth year of his reign, in the tenth month, on the tenth day of the month, King Nebuchadrezzar of Babylon came with all his army against Jerusalem, and they laid siege to it; they built siegeworks against it all around.
text_cn: 漆德克雅为王九年十月十日，巴比伦王拿步高率领全军来进攻耶路撒冷，扎营围城，在城四周建筑了壁垒，

text_en: So the city was besieged until the eleventh year of King Zedekiah.
text_cn: 围攻京城，直至漆德克雅为王十一年。

text_en: On the ninth day of the fourth month the famine became so severe in the city that there was no food for the people of the land.
text_cn: 是年四月九日，城中发生了严重的饥荒，当地人民已没有粮食，

text_en: Then a breach was made in the city wall; and all the soldiers fled and went out from the city by night by the way of the gate between the two walls, by the king’s garden, though the Chaldeans were all around the city. They went in the direction of the Arabah.
text_cn: 京城遂被攻破，加色丁人还在围攻京城时，君王和全体士兵，黑夜出了靠近御苑的双墙城门，逃往阿辣巴。

text_en: But the army of the Chaldeans pursued the king, and overtook Zedekiah in the plains of Jericho; and all his army was scattered, deserting him.
text_cn: 加色丁军队便追赶君王，在耶里哥旷野追上了漆德克雅。此时他的军队已离开他逃散了。

text_en: Then they captured the king, and brought him up to the king of Babylon at Riblah in the land of Hamath, and he passed sentence on him.
text_cn: 加色丁军队擒获了君王，带他上哈玛特地的黎贝拉去见巴比伦王，巴比伦王即宣判了他的罪案。

text_en: The king of Babylon killed the sons of Zedekiah before his eyes, and also killed all the officers of Judah at Riblah.
text_cn: 巴比伦王在黎贝拉当着漆德克雅眼前杀了他的儿子，和犹大的众首领，

text_en: He put out the eyes of Zedekiah, and bound him in fetters, and the king of Babylon took him to Babylon, and put him in prison until the day of his death.
text_cn: 然后剜了漆德克雅的眼，给他带上锁链，送往巴比伦去，直到他死，囚在监内。

text_en: In the fifth month, on the tenth day of the month—which was the nineteenth year of King Nebuchadrezzar, king of Babylon—Nebuzaradan the captain of the bodyguard who served the king of Babylon, entered Jerusalem.
text_cn: 巴比伦王拿步高为王十九年五月十日，侍立于巴比伦王左右的卫队长乃步匝辣当来到了耶路撒冷，

text_en: He burned the house of the Lord , the king’s house, and all the houses of Jerusalem; every great house he burned down.
text_cn: 焚毁了上主的殿、王宫和耶路撒冷所有的民房；凡是高大的建筑都用火烧了。

text_en: All the army of the Chaldeans, who were with the captain of the guard, broke down all the walls around Jerusalem.
text_cn: 跟随卫队长的所有加色丁军队，拆毁了耶路撒冷周围的城墙；

text_en: Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard carried into exile some of the poorest of the people and the rest of the people who were left in the city and the deserters who had defected to the king of Babylon, together with the rest of the artisans.
text_cn: 城中剩下的人民和已投降巴比伦王的人以及剩下的工匠，卫队长乃步匝辣当都掳了去，

text_en: But Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard left some of the poorest people of the land to be vinedressers and tillers of the soil.
text_cn: 只留下了当地一部分最穷的平民，作园丁和农民。

text_en: The pillars of bronze that were in the house of the Lord , and the stands and the bronze sea that were in the house of the Lord , the Chaldeans broke in pieces, and carried all the bronze to Babylon.
text_cn: 加色丁人又将上主殿内的铜柱，和上主殿内的铜座、铜海都打碎，把铜都运往巴比伦；

text_en: They took away the pots, the shovels, the snuffers, the basins, the ladles, and all the vessels of bronze used in the temple service.
text_cn: 此外锅、铲、蜡剪、盆碟、香盘，以及行礼用的一切铜器，全都带走；

text_en: The captain of the guard took away the small bowls also, the firepans, the basins, the pots, the lampstands, the ladles, and the bowls for libation, both those of gold and those of silver.
text_cn: 爵杯、提炉、盆碟、锅子、蜡台、勺子和盆盂（yú），凡是纯金纯银的，卫队长也都拿走了。

text_en: As for the two pillars, the one sea, the twelve bronze bulls that were under the sea, and the stands, which King Solomon had made for the house of the Lord , the bronze of all these vessels was beyond weighing.
text_cn: 撒罗满王为上主殿做的两根柱子，一个铜海和下面的十二个铜牛，及十个盆座：这些器皿的铜，重量无法估计。

text_en: As for the pillars, the height of the one pillar was eighteen cubits, its circumference was twelve cubits; it was hollow and its thickness was four fingers.
text_cn: 至于两根柱子，每根高十八肘；周围是十二肘，有四指厚，中空。

text_en: Upon it was a capital of bronze; the height of the capital was five cubits; latticework and pomegranates, all of bronze, encircled the top of the capital. And the second pillar had the same, with pomegranates.
text_cn: 每根柱子上面有铜柱头，高五肘，柱头四周有网子和石榴，全是铜的；另一柱子同样也有像这样的装饰和石榴。

text_en: There were ninety-six pomegranates on the sides; all the pomegranates encircling the latticework numbered one hundred.
text_cn: 石榴有九十六个，往下悬着；网子四周共有一百个石榴。

text_en: The captain of the guard took the chief priest Seraiah, the second priest Zephaniah, and the three guardians of the threshold;
text_cn: 卫队长又擒获了大司祭色辣雅，副大司祭责法尼雅和三个门丁，

text_en: and from the city he took an officer who had been in command of the soldiers, and seven men of the king’s council who were found in the city; the secretary of the commander of the army who mustered the people of the land; and sixty men of the people of the land who were found inside the city.
text_cn: 由城中还擒获了一个管理军队的宦官，七个在城里搜到的君王的亲信，一个征募当地人民的军长的书记，和城中搜到的六十个当地平民。

text_en: Then Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took them, and brought them to the king of Babylon at Riblah.
text_cn: 卫队长乃步匝辣当捉住他们带到黎贝拉去见巴比伦王；

text_en: And the king of Babylon struck them down, and put them to death at Riblah in the land of Hamath. So Judah went into exile out of its land.
text_cn: 巴比伦王就在哈玛特地的黎贝拉将他们杀了。从此，犹大人由本乡被掳去充军。

text_en: This is the number of the people whom Nebuchadrezzar took into exile: in the seventh year, three thousand twenty-three Judeans;
text_cn: 以下是拿步高掳去的人数：在第七年掳去的犹大人，为数是三千零二十三人。

text_en: in the eighteenth year of Nebuchadrezzar he took into exile from Jerusalem eight hundred thirty-two persons;
text_cn: 拿步高第十八年，由耶路撒冷掳去的是八百三十二人；

text_en: in the twenty-third year of Nebuchadrezzar, Nebuzaradan the captain of the guard took into exile of the Judeans seven hundred forty-five persons; all the persons were four thousand six hundred.
text_cn: 拿步高第二十三年，卫队长乃步匝辣当掳去了七百四十五名犹大人：掳去的人数共计是四千六百名。

text_en: In the thirty-seventh year of the exile of King Jehoiachin of Judah, in the twelfth month, on the twenty-fifth day of the month, King Evil-merodach of Babylon, in the year he began to reign, showed favor to King Jehoiachin of Judah and brought him out of prison;
text_cn: 犹大王耶苛尼雅被掳后第三十七年，十二月二十五日，巴比伦王厄威耳默洛达客登极元年，大赦犹大王耶苛尼雅，放他出狱，

text_en: he spoke kindly to him, and gave him a seat above the seats of the other kings who were with him in Babylon.
text_cn: 亲切与他交谈，令他坐在与他一同在巴比伦的众王之上，

text_en: So Jehoiachin put aside his prison clothes, and every day of his life he dined regularly at the king’s table.
text_cn: 脱去他的囚衣，以后一生日日与王共进饮食。

text_en: For his allowance, a regular daily allowance was given him by the king of Babylon, as long as he lived, up to the day of his death.
text_cn: 他的生活费用，在他有生之日，直到他死，每天不断由巴比伦王供应。
